$comment: AnA tool register (P1-34). One entry per registered tool: its class, what it writes, where. Classes and the input rules are explained in tool-authorization.ts. Classification evidence: docs/evidence/D6/2026-09-26-p1-34/.

ack_training.writes: training attestation in the user's name (method 'attestation', model-supplied quiz_score)
ack_training.why: A training acknowledgement is the trainee’s own attestation; they record it themselves on the document’s training record.

act_on_screen.writes: view-only screen directive and in-turn program focus

add_capa_action.writes: INSERT protocol_capa_actions; deviation -> capa_pending + governed-action row

add_labeling_translation.rule: input.back_translation_verified === true -> refuse (verification claim); else confirm

add_risk_control.rule: input.status in (verified, effective) or verification_evidence/effectiveness_evidence supplied -> refuse; else confirm

answer_intelligence_question.writes: AnA interview session state (tenant record written by commit_intelligence_flow)

apply_fact_change.writes: re-versions a canonical fact; drift cascade; audit

apply_protocol_design_derivation.writes: overwrites bound study design + governed-action row

approve_import.writes: INSERT concept2cure_artifacts (draft); import job completed; human route needs no e-signature

approve_no_cost_extension.writes: none; the handler already refuses (e-signed route)
approve_no_cost_extension.why: An approval is an e-signed act: the person does it with the Approve button, which asks for their password and second factor.

approve_qms_document.writes: none; the handler already refuses (e-signed route)
approve_qms_document.why: An approval is an e-signed act: the person does it with the Approve button, which asks for their password and second factor.

approve_rbm_assessment.writes: none; the handler already refuses (signed route)
approve_rbm_assessment.why: An approval is an e-signed act: the person does it with the Approve button, which asks for their password and second factor.

approve_rbm_plan.writes: none; the handler already refuses (signed route)
approve_rbm_plan.why: An approval is an e-signed act: the person does it with the Approve button, which asks for their password and second factor.

assemble_briefing_book.rule: run_premortem !== false with numeric package_id and assessment_id -> confirm; else read

assemble_crl_premortem_artifact.writes: scratch .docx under tmp/docbuilder when export is true

assess_site_risk.writes: deletes and re-inserts the program's rbm_site_risk_scores snapshot (also when no snapshot exists, without persist)

bind_protocol_to_study_design.writes: UPDATE protocol_documents study_design link + governed-action row

cast_committee_vote.writes: casts/overwrites a member's vote — the member's own act
cast_committee_vote.why: A committee vote is the member’s own act; each member casts it from the agenda item.

certify_other_support.writes: none; the handler already refuses (certification is the investigator's own)
certify_other_support.why: Certifying Other Support is the investigator’s own certification, which they sign.

check_submission_status.writes: agency-polling gateways UPDATE submission_transmittals.status (target-dependent; fail closed)

classify_submission_document.writes: UPDATE coauthor_documents classification; can place a leaf into a sequence

commit_document_revision.writes: new artifact version; status -> review by default; audit

convene_committee_meeting.writes: UPSERT attendance; meeting status convened + governed-action row

convene_drafting_council.writes: lumen council working/audit rows; final text not saved to a tenant record

convert_docx_to_pdf.writes: writes or overwrites a PDF next to the input or at output_pdf_path
convert_docx_to_pdf.rule: output path under tmp/ -> self; otherwise (uploads/) -> confirm

create_clinical_study.writes: INSERT clinical_studies; irb_approved records an IRB approval fact

create_per_document.rule: input.per_status in (approved, superseded) -> refuse; else confirm

create_software_lifecycle_item.rule: status in (approved, superseded) -> refuse; else confirm

draft_authoring_document.writes: creates an authoring document, sections, revisions + audit

establish_governed_fact.writes: inserts an active canonical fact + audit

execute_platform_command.writes: whatever the command does; the command partition (command-rbac.ts, part11-governance.ts) classifies it
execute_platform_command.rule: command effect read -> read; write -> confirm (proposed by the command partition); PART11 e-sign command -> refuse

execute_research_agreement.writes: none; the handler already refuses (execution is a signed act)
execute_research_agreement.why: Executing an agreement is a signed act a person performs on the agreement.

execute_subaward.writes: none; the handler already refuses (execution is a signed act)
execute_subaward.why: Executing a subaward is a signed act a person performs on the subaward.

fetch_template_and_fill.writes: scratch filled .docx under tmp/docbuilder, not filed

finalize_biosketch.why: Finalizing is a signed act the person performs on its own surface.

finalize_committee_determination.why: Finalizing is a signed act the person performs on its own surface.

finalize_dms_plan.why: Finalizing is a signed act the person performs on its own surface.

finalize_export_control_determination.why: Finalizing is a signed act the person performs on its own surface.

finalize_grant_closeout.why: Finalizing is a signed act the person performs on its own surface.

finalize_protocol_document.why: Finalizing is a signed act the person performs on its own surface.

generate_document.rule: input.output_format === 'xml' -> confirm (its path is built from the unsanitised title); else self

generate_se_matrix.writes: POST to the shadow review service with an admin token (unverified whether it persists; fail closed)

ind_generate_section.writes: loopback POST that creates an artifact for the given project

log_cs_transaction.writes: INSERT cs_transactions + balance update + governed-action row
log_cs_transaction.rule: input.witnessed_by non-empty -> refuse (third-party witness attestation); else confirm

package_ectd_for_region.writes: writes an eCTD zip to output_dir

place_project_document.rule: input.confirm_suggested === true -> refuse (the handler already refuses); else confirm

project_csr_evidence.writes: bulk-creates evidence sources, studies and relationships

qms_change_transition.rule: input.to in (approved, closed) -> refuse; else confirm

read_project_document.writes: her read-coverage receipt; extraction outcome backfill

record_grant_award.writes: INSERT grant_awards; proposal -> awarded + governed-action row

report_protocol_deviation.rule: input.severity and input.affects_safety both supplied -> refuse (stamps the person's reportability assessment); else confirm

retire_qms_document.writes: retires a controlled document (terminal); the handler requires a reason of 8+ characters and records a governed action

review_schedule_of_events_health.writes: milestone status changes, tasks, org notifications (apply defaults true)

revise_qms_document.writes: opens a controlled revision (reason required): document back to draft, approval cleared; the effective version is withdrawn in place (hand-on) + governed-action row

run_python_script.writes: runs model code, writes output files to tmp

save_document_to_vault.writes: new governed artifact + version + governed-action row

scan_document_citations.writes: binds citations to governed facts, writes drift rows

set_registration_status.rule: input.market_status === 'approved' -> refuse (asserts a marketing authorization); else confirm

start_deep_investigation.writes: INSERT ana_deep_investigations and starts an unattended background run

start_war_game.writes: her own WAR_GAME_RUN audit entry; engine is pure

suggest_predicate_devices.writes: POST to the shadow review service with an admin token (unverified whether it persists; fail closed)

surgical_docx_xml_edit.writes: scratch edited .docx under tmp/docbuilder, not filed

transmit_submission.writes: none; the handler already refuses (transmission is a person's signed act)
transmit_submission.why: Transmitting a submission to an agency is a person’s authorised, signed act, done from the Submission Center.

update_invention_disclosure.rule: input.status in (elected, patent_filed, licensed, released, abandoned) or input.election_date -> refuse; else confirm

update_plan.writes: no side effect; plan UI event

update_research_agreement.writes: UPDATE research_agreements + audit (executed refused by service)

update_tmf_artifact_status.rule: input.status === 'final' -> refuse (TMF QC finalization); else confirm

update_vault_document.writes: new artifact version (approved-status overwrite noted as finding)

verify_memory_atom.writes: marks a memory atom verified by the user (the yes is the verification)
